# laravel-action-otp

Confirm any action with a one-time code sent by mail or SMS. Package jtargosz/laravel-action-otp 2.x, PHP 8.3+, Laravel 13. Facade Jtargosz\ActionOtp\Facades\ActionOtp. Not TOTP, not passkeys, not a ready-made login screen. Full docs: README.md.

## Install

composer require jtargosz/laravel-action-otp
php artisan vendor:publish --tag=action-otp-config
php artisan make:otp-action RegisterUserAction   (generates App\OtpActions\RegisterUserAction, --force overwrites)

## Action

class RegisterUserAction implements Jtargosz\ActionOtp\Contracts\VerifiableAction
{
    public function __construct(public string $name, public string $email, public string $passwordHash) {}
    public function handle(): mixed { return User::create([...]); }
}

send() stores the action in cache and sends a code. verify() deletes the code, then runs handle() once; its return value is the payload.

## API

ActionOtp::to(string|int $identifier)   scope to an identifier
->for(string $purpose)                  default "default"; one pending action per purpose
->withChallenge(?string $token)         token from send(), for API clients
->send(VerifiableAction $action, object $notifiable): sent + challenge | throttled
->verify(string $code): verified + payload | empty | mismatch | expired | throttled
->peek(string $code): matched (code kept, handle() not run) | empty | mismatch | expired | throttled
->resend(): sent (new code, same challenge) | empty | throttled
->clear(): void   deletes the pending code only

OtpResult: status (OtpStatus), message (translated), payload, challenge; ok(), found(), toArray().
OtpStatus: sent, matched, verified, empty, mismatch, throttled, expired, device_mismatch.
Codes are strings: leading zeros kept, whitespace trimmed, letters case-insensitive.

Challenge lookup: withChallenge() token, then the browser session, then (only #[AnyDevice]) the last pending action. No challenge: empty, no attempt counted.
API client: $token = ActionOtp::to($email)->for('login')->send($action, $user)->challenge;
            ActionOtp::to($email)->for('login')->withChallenge($token)->verify($code);

## Rules

- Hash passwords (Hash::make) before building the action. The action waits in cache.
- Normalize identifiers (strtolower emails). They are compared exactly.
- Never use #[AnyDevice] for login, password reset, email change or anything that grants access.
- peek() and the ValidOtpCode rule count a wrong code as an attempt.
- The challenge is a bearer secret for one pending action.
- Throttling is per identifier across purposes: max_attempts wrong tries in one hour lock for throttle_seconds, send_cooldown between sends. Only a successful verify resets them.

## Attributes (Jtargosz\ActionOtp\Attributes, inherited)

#[Ttl(10)] minutes, #[CodeFormat('alphanumeric')], #[CodeLength(8)], #[SendWith(CodeSms::class)], #[AnyDevice]

## Validation

new Jtargosz\ActionOtp\Validation\ValidOtpCode($identifier, $purpose = 'default', $challenge = null)

## Routes (optional)

ActionOtp::routes($prefix = 'otp', $middleware = ['web']):
POST otp/verify (identifier, code, purpose, challenge), POST otp/resend (identifier, purpose, challenge), GET/POST otp/link (signed magic link), GET/POST otp/confirm and POST otp/confirm/resend (auth, otp.confirm).
ActionOtp::identifyUsing(fn (Request $r) => $r->session()->get('login.email')) takes the identifier for verify/resend from the server; the request field is ignored, null answers empty.
JSON: {status, message} with 200, 409 device_mismatch, 422, 429. Replace by binding Contracts\VerifyResponse.
Magic link: config link.enabled, ActionOtp::linkView('view') with data url, purpose. GET shows the page, POST verifies.
otp.confirm middleware: ActionOtp::confirmView('view') with data submitUrl, resendUrl. ActionOtp::confirmUsing(fn ($user) => $user->phone). JSON 423 when unconfirmed. RequireOtpConfirmation::using($route, $seconds).

## Notifications

Default Jtargosz\ActionOtp\Mail\CodeMail (queued, encrypted, views tag action-otp-views). A custom notification takes __construct(public OtpMessage $otp). OtpMessage: code, expiresAt, purpose, link, smsText(?string $host) ending with "@host #code".

## Testing

ActionOtp::fake('123456') records sends, storage and throttling stay real.
assertSent(Action::class, fn ($action, $message, $identifier, $purpose) => ...), assertSentTimes, assertNotSent, assertNothingSent, assertVerified(Action::class, fn ($action, $payload, $identifier, $purpose) => ...), assertNotVerified.
codeFor($identifier, $purpose = 'default'), challengeFor(...), messageFor(...).

## Config, events, AI tools

Config keys: see config/action-otp.php.
Events (no code, no action): CodeSent(identifier, purpose, expiresAt), CodeVerified(identifier, purpose, payload), CodeFailed(identifier, purpose).
AI tools (laravel/ai): Jtargosz\ActionOtp\Ai\ResendOtpTool and CheckOtpTool, both ($identifier, $purpose = 'default', $challenge = null). The model supplies only the code.
